The main takeaway from our work is that

the aerobic VC degrading bacteria we isolated from groundwater microcosms were not previously described as VC degraders and that these organisms are likely to be important contributors to VC degradation in groundwater.
aerobic VC metabolism in GW is likely to be more complex than previously thought, with a number of bacterial species participating in VC metabolism.
